t: The Git Stash Gambit: Automating Defaults and User Customization
s: A novel Git workflow using `stash`, `pull`, and `apply` intelligently manages local user customizations against developer-provided defaults in automated updates, preventing conflicts and ensuring system stability. This approach, coupled with architectural refactoring for circular imports, creates a self-healing system.
sub: Automating Git stash/pull/apply for configuration updates
Balancing developer defaults with user customizations
Resolving circular import dependencies in Python
Nix and Git for reproducible, maintainable software
